about: Telemetry contract recorded from the vanilla UI (commit e0b1099) before the React redesign. The new UI must reproduce the envelope, the payload keys per event type, the enum values and the event sequence of the scripted flow below. Only study_version may change (it is bumped when the new UI ships).

values.run_id: r<n>, counting every run attempt in the page session (including runs made before consent)

flow: Fresh state. Open Screen an Idea → consent dialog → decline. Run the legal idea → expect 0 events.
Read the study information → agree. Set the pre-use trust slider to 3.
Go to Cohort Dashboard, open demo report idea-01, close it, go back to Screen an Idea.
Run the legal idea (run 1 after consent). Open then close claim 0's evidence. Rate claim 0 disagree, claim 1 agree.
Click a source link on claim 0 (mock runs have no sources: inject one link to exercise the handler).
Bring the graveyard panel, then the objector panel, into view. Edit reviewer notes and leave the box.
Post-use trust 5, answer all 5 Likert items, comment, submit.
Run again twice (the second run ends the first with new_run). Fire pagehide. Point PROXY_URL at a dead port and run once (fails).
order_tolerance: graveyard_viewed and objections_viewed depend on layout and scroll; each must appear exactly once per run, between that run's run_completed and the event that ends it. Their relative order may differ.
known_issue: Panel-viewed events use IntersectionObserver threshold 0.5 of the panel's own height, so a panel taller than twice the viewport (e.g. on phones) never reports as viewed. Recorded as-is; fix pending a decision.
